{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.84

|gr1= GUI Control - Object

|descr= Process an animation of 3D [[Arma: GUI Configuration]]. Command uses name defined by source property and works similar like [[animateSource]] command.

|s1= control [[ctrlAnimateModel]] [source, phase, speed]

|p1= control : [[Control]] - 3D control

|p2= source: [[String]] - common source

|p3= phase: [[Number]] - wanted animation phase

|p4= speed: [[Boolean]] or [[Number]] - (Optional, default [[false]])
* [[Boolean]] - when set to [[true]], animation is instant
* {{GVI|arma3|1.66|size= 0.75}} [[Number]] - > 0 is treated as config speed value multiplier

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>_control3D ctrlAnimateModel ["Close", 1];</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>_ctrlLaptop ctrlAnimateModel ["Lid", 1, 2];</sqf>

|seealso= [[ctrlAnimationPhaseModel]] [[ctrlCreate]] [[ctrlDelete]] [[ctrlModel]] [[ctrlPosition]] [[ctrlSetPosition]] [[ctrlClassName]] [[displayCtrl]] [[ctrlModelScale]] [[ctrlSetModelScale]] [[ctrlModelDirAndUp]] [[ctrlSetModelDirAndUp]]
}}
